verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own Split feature automatically divides inbound funds across multiple parties when they arrive. That is a narrow, product-native rule-on-event behavior. Webhooks are only a building block a developer would use to build their own rule engine, so they earn no credit here, and scheduled transfers are time-based rather than event-triggered. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rules/automation engine (configurable triggers, conditions and actions), documentation of how split rules are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Split inbound funds across multiple parties at the moment they arrive
